eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Lincoln, WA; at 7:28 PM on AUG 13, 2025 Effective until 11:28 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Level 3 Evacuation notice, Prepare to leave the area due to fire. If you live between Farwell Rd and the Spokane River.  And if you live between Mclaughlin Rd and State Route 231.  Be prepared to evacuate.  A fire is burning on top of the cliffs at Whispering Pines and at the Bottom of the cliffs moving north towards the river near Devils Gap & Long Lake Rd.
